$comment: Direction: Swift to Rust. Protocol 38. Local IPC only. A tap on the one-time invitation to turn the question after a block on (work_block_state.rating_opt_in): turn_on is true for Turn on and false for Not now. A fact about which button was tapped, and nothing else. The service decides what it records: Turn on turns the question on, refused until this Mac's first 14 days of blocks are over, as the Settings toggle is; Not now is recorded only while the invitation is still owed, so it is never shown again, and a Not now on an invitation left on screen after the question was turned on changes nothing. Closing the popover is not Not now and sends nothing. Answered with work_block_state, which no longer carries the invitation once it is answered.
